title: Downwind of Mossreach
html:
Ossa Penhallow has watched Mossreach Swamp creep forty paces past her old cutting beds in three years, and she thinks the harpies on Gregor's road and the moving bog are the same story.

About

Given byOssa Penhallow
Level30
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points2

What you need

  • Mire Essence ×5

Steps

  1. Talk to Ossa Penhallow (outdoors near Trollbarrow) to get the quest.
  2. Thin the bogs out of Mossreach (12)
    Collect 5 jars of mire essence and bring them to Ossa Penhallow (5) - Mire Essence at 1186, -350
  3. Report back to Ossa Penhallow at 1186, -350

Rewards

Reward
Gold600
Character XP27,000
Quest points2

What Ossa Penhallow says

Ossa Penhallow: It's not water.

Ossa Penhallow: Hold it up. It doesn't run, it creeps, and it creeps the same way whichever way you tip the jar.

Ossa Penhallow: I've cut peat out here twenty-six years. I've never had a jar do that.

You: So it isn't the harpies.

Ossa Penhallow: Gregor's road isn't a harpy problem. It never was.

Ossa Penhallow: But the harpies are the part that's killing drivers. So that's the part we do first.

Handing it in

"The jar's still on my shelf, and it still creeps the same way."
